pixelReview.method: Directly inspected all10 current caption sheets and all8 current composition sheets, plus current full-size negative-sign fractional-power branch and one-sided scalar spot frames. Every226 narration cue and every scene represented.
checks: Every narration cue is readable, at most two lines, with fixed bottom-center boxed-white-forest captions.
Actual ski, rocket, snowboard and bicycle actions remain visible above captions; edited excerpts are explicitly distinguished from one continuous action or private game-engine evidence.
Hamilton wxyz/RH column convention, conjugate versus total sign, general inverse squared norm, application order and framed deltas match narration.
Four-component dot/absolute value/doubled acos, q/-q zero endpoint distance, q90 half45 versus selected -q90 half-135 path branch are correct.
One-sided (1,0,1) product scalar -sqrt2/2, two-sided vector(0,1,1), unchanged Z and unit-conjugate inverse exercise match current narration.
White depth presentation, original2-second cats and10-second member photo/name/badges with canonical coaching URL are preserved.
